body: When Juice WRLD Got Off His Tour Bus In Front Of Fans, Some Of Them Took A Moment To Realize It Was Actually Him Despite His Rapid Rise To Fame, Juice Still Carried Himself Like A Regular Person. His Manager Peter Jideonwo Recalled That Juice Would Often Get Off The Tour Bus To Talk With Fans, Shake Hands And Take Pictures, Even Saying He Was One Of The Most Humble And Friendly Artists He Had Worked With.

When Juice WRLD Got Off His Tour Bus In Front Of Fans, Some Of Them Took A Moment To Realize It Was Actually Him 😂👀
